name: taskboard
description: A local-first Jira Cloud client for macOS

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist/src/windows/settings && cp index.html dist/ && cp src/windows/settings/index.html dist/src/windows/settings/
scripts.lint: bun run types && git diff --exit-code -- src/api/types.gen.ts && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --lib --bins -- -D warnings
